title: Recipe Finder
description: Build a recipe finder that searches by ingredients, filters by cook time, and combines search criteria.

steps.title: Recipe data array
steps.description: Create an array of recipe objects with `name`, `ingredients` (array), `cookTime` (minutes), and `difficulty` properties. Include at least 4 recipes.
hints: ingredients should be an array of strings

codeTemplate.python:
recipes = [
    # Your code here - at least 4 recipes
]
import json
print(json.dumps(recipes))

verification.failureMessage: Include name, ingredients, cookTime, and difficulty for at least 4 recipes.

steps.title: searchByIngredient function
steps.description: Write `searchByIngredient(recipes, ingredient)` that filters recipes containing a given ingredient (case-insensitive).
hints: Convert ingredient to lowercase for comparison
Use .some() to check if any ingredient matches

verification.failureMessage: Return recipes that contain the given ingredient.

steps.title: searchByTime function
steps.description: Write `searchByTime(recipes, maxMinutes)` that returns recipes with `cookTime` less than or equal to `maxMinutes`.

steps.title: Combined search
steps.description: Write `searchRecipes(recipes, filters)` that accepts a filters object with `ingredient` and `maxTime` properties and applies both filters.
hints: Start with the full recipes array

verification.failureMessage: Apply both ingredient and time filters.

steps.title: Recipe detail string
steps.description: Write `formatRecipe(recipe)` that returns a formatted string: `'[name] - [cookTime] min - [difficulty]\nIngredients: [ingredients list]'`.
hints: Combine all fields into one string
